html:
The Herat earthquakes were a series of four strong earthquakes, each of magnitude 6.3, that struck Herat province in western Afghanistan in October 2023. The first two came on 7 October, the others on 11 and 15 October.

The quakes hit farming villages northwest of the city of Herat, where houses were built of mud brick. Whole villages were flattened. The World Health Organization counted about 1,500 dead and over 2,000 injured. Many of the dead were women and children, who were at home when the first shocks came while many men worked outside.

The disaster came at a hard time. Since the Taliban took power in 2021, much foreign aid had been cut, and the government had little money for rescue. Herat is one of the great historic cities of Central Asia, once the capital of the Timurid Empire and home of the poet Ali-Shir Nava'i.
sum: The Herat earthquakes were a series of four strong earthquakes, each of magnitude 6.3, that struck Herat province in western Afghanistan in October 2023. The first two came on 7 October, the others on 11 and 15 October.
